description: STRATEGIC KNOWLEDGE — the documented ruleset + knowledge for a geography, so an AI does not have to KNOW the rules; the platform supplies them. Two tiers MERGED on read: (1) a system-seeded, CITED GLOBAL canonical…

geo_id.description: The geography handle — a state postal/FIPS/name (state level), a 5-digit county FIPS (county level), or a precinct id (precinct level). County/precinct inherit their parent state's global rules.

party.description: Optional — which party's rules to return (allocation method + viability differ by party). Default D.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: get_geo_knowledge
